notes.title: 0.5.8 update is out!
notes.content:
Hello! So we released the first update from our new development cycle.
[list]
[*]New second level (alpha version) As we said, we are doing the second level from scratch. Only now, instead of doing it for a very long time, and then immediately releasing it ready, we decided to release it in pieces. In the first update: a new terrain, some basic mechanics and achievements. It is still far from what is planned. And to be honest, you can hardly call it playable, but it's better than nothing.
[*]Alternative (fast) ending. Now the game has the first of 3 possible endings. Although it is short, but getting it is not so easy)
[*]Difficulty levels in story mode. Now you can choose at what level of difficulty you want to go through the plot: easy - the labyrinth is smaller, the monsters and the Minotaur are weaker; normal - everything is as planned; hard - the labyrinth is bigger, and the monsters and the Minotaur are stronger. In easy mode, the player does not receive achievements, and in hard mode you will receive a special achievement. Also now leaderboards are divided into difficulties.
[*]Switchable view bobbing when running, walking, etc. Some players have asked to do this because they are getting nauseous.
[*]Fixed a ceiling bug. Optimized and improved sounds.
[/list]
In the next update, we will have an event prepared in anticipation of the Spring Festival (Chinese New Year), and will also completely redo the endless mode.

notes.title: How to recover old saves after the recent update
notes.content:
In the recent update the executable file and data folder have been renamed so thats caused save files to lose. But thanks to [b]Nice Puppies[/b] we have a solution:

[quote]
I noticed that after I got the recent 0.5.1 update, all of my game settings were reset when I started up the game. I found out why. Before this update, the game's save files were saved at: "Steam\SteamApps\common\Ancient Guardian\lab_data\save". Now they are saved in a different location: "Steam\SteamApps\common\Ancient Guardian\AncientGuardian_Data\save". If you want to recover your old settings, you can simply just go into the "lab_data\save" folder and cut the two files that are in there (profile.dat and settings.dat), and paste those two files into the new location which is mentioned above. Then you can delete the "lab_data" folder because it's not needed anymore
[/quote]

Cheers!

notes.title: Results of testing the second level
notes.content:
Hello, we would like to share the results of testing the second act.
[list]
[*]Decrease the area of ​​the level. At the moment it is quite large, so the player has to run a lot. Also, too much distance from the start to the first pedestals and the distance between them is too large.
[*]Balance the burning time of the torch. At the second level, instead of the flashlight, the hero has a torch that illuminates the path, but also drives away the different creatures from player.
[*]To think over the transitions through the water. No comments.
[*]More diverse monsters. And also work on AI.
[*]Optimization.
[*]Forest revitalization, more content, color correction.
[*]More interactive, random events.
[/list]
In general, as usual there are a lot of work, but we are not discouraged, because in the end we will be able to give a quality level that will be of interest to the player.

notes.title: Work on the lobby is over!
notes.content:
Finally, we have finished work on the lobby!ːminotaurː
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/3b7eec9f9d27eacb6597b9c87b1972c8444551a6.png[/img]
Along with this news, we would like to tell you how the distribution of the Minotaur will work. Let's say at once, everything is random, neither the player, nor the server, in general, no one can choose whether the Minotaur will be controlled by a player or AI. Also, if the Minotaur is controlled by a player, then the choice of who will control it will be random. But there are some exceptions:
[list]
[*]If there are two players, the Minotaur can be either an AI or an random player. [i](2 heroes + Minotaur-AI // 1 hero + Minotaur-player)[/i]
[*]If there are three players, the Minotaur can also be an AI or an random player. [i](3 heroes + Minotaur-AI // 2 hero + Minotaur-player)[/i]
[*]If there are four players, then the Minotaur will be an random player, AI is unavailable. [i](3 heroes + Minotaur-player)[/i]
[/list]
Unfortunately, the work on the multiplayer is not progressing as fast as we would like, but the work does not stop. We also wanted to say that the first phase will be the longest and most complicated, since on it we create a foundation/base, on which in the future we will introduce new features and fix bugs.

Let's say at once, everything is random, neither the player, nor the server, in general, no one can choose whether the Minotaur will be controlled by a player or AI. Also, if the Minotaur is controlled by a player, then the choice of who will control it will be random. But there are some exceptions:
[list]
[*]If there are two players, the Minotaur can be either an AI or an random player. [i](2 heroes + Minotaur-AI // 1 hero + Minotaur-player)[/i]
[*]If there are three players, the Minotaur can also be an AI or an random player. [i](3 heroes + Minotaur-AI // 2 hero + Minotaur-player)[/i]
[*]If there are four players, then the Minotaur will be an random player, AI is unavailable. [i](3 heroes + Minotaur-player)[/i]
[/list]
Unfortunately, the work on the multiplayer is not progressing as fast as we would like, but the work does not stop. We also wanted to say that the first phase will be the longest and most complicated, since on it we create a foundation/base, on which in the future we will introduce new features and fix bugs.

tags.feature: Finally, we have finished work on the lobby!:minotaur:

notes.title: Information about the first phase of multiplayer!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/1e95a2fa1b3df5d6debf197dbbc0338ffe747137.png[/img]

Good day, friends! As we promised, we will share information about the first phase of the multiplayer.

The first phase will include:
[list]
[*]A new menu for multiplayer, in which you can create a game, join an existing game or view information about a profile.
[*]The first makings of the rank system, the levels and experience for passing the levels.
[*]Spectator mode after death.
[*]Lobby, character selection (there will be only one character at this stage), distribution of the Minotaur.
[*]Chat.
[*]Actually the multiplayer itself.
[/list]

If all tests pass without problems, then there is a possibility that multiplayer will appear already this month, but we can not give 100% guarantees.

Thanks!

notes.title: New update has arrived!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27220595/e3d3bc4c98cfdf730bea9eb01465e6e6a32bc00f.png[/img]
Hello, friends! We are pleased to announce that work on a major update is over. In this update, our main focus was on gameplay and new content. Thanks to your feedback game become better and we are very grateful to you! We look forward to further communication and, with the help of which you can tell us more about game, what you like and do not like, so we can know exactly in which direction we should move.

Update key features:
[list]
[*]A more friendly gameplay
[*]Many fixes
[*]New game mode
[*]Steam cards, smiles, backgrounds and badges
[*]New content
[/list]
[i]*For more details, see the corresponding news[/i]

What we going to do next? Next, we plan to produce about the same kind of update, but this time focus will be on the technical part of the game, in particular, controls settings and optimization. Also, we will continue to add new content, we are already working on this and we hope that you will not be disappointed!

Thanks!
